title: Imprivata SSO, Badge-Tap & EPCS Integration for Clinical Endpoints
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: integrate Imprivata (SSO, badge tap, EPCS).

Scope: deploy Imprivata OneSign agent + proximity reader drivers via Intune to shared clinical endpoints; configure tap-and-go badge SSO, fast user switching, SSO into Epic/clinical web apps, and EPCS two-factor (Confirm ID). Imprivata appliance/console + EPCS/DEA specifics deferred to the customer's Imprivata admin and compliance team. White-label.
pricing: T4 — auth across shared clinical fleet + regulated EPCS workflow + multiple integrations.
